findingDetails.title: addNamedSurfaces leaves the 5l fixtures non-canon-clean
findingDetails.case: A future edit that relies on the 5l fixtures being otherwise green misreads them: addNamedSurfaces registers surface modes but never sets routerPolicy.outcomes.surfaceBundle, never extends description.json keywords or the demo vocabulary class, and never calls regenerateManifest, so every 5l run carries unrelated drift (5f surfaceBundle softFail, 5k alias/packet drift, 10b stale manifest).
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Tests 2 and 3 assert only 5l lines, so the drift does not invalidate the pins; the sk-code fixture is already red by design (5k-canary), so exit codes were never the discriminating evidence.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The helper may deliberately stay minimal because only 5l lines matter; that explains tests 2 and 3 but not the divergence from both sibling helpers' canon-clean discipline, nor test 1's exit-code assertion, which cannot discriminate 5l's FAIL from the drift.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If a fixture-hygiene policy for sk-code cases is recorded this becomes a note; if the assertions are tightened to require an otherwise-green run, re-score to P1.
findingDetails.recommendation: Have addNamedSurfaces mirror addSurfaceMode: set outcomes.surfaceBundle, extend description.json keywords and the demo vocabulary class, and call regenerateManifest after writing the packets.
